title: Proposal agent response
description: Envelope for every proposal agent reply. The document is validated against schemas/<documentType>.schema.json when the status is awaiting_confirmation or complete.

status.description: needs_input while mandatory data is missing, awaiting_confirmation while the summary waits for the user's confirmation, complete after confirmation.

documentType.description: Selected document type, or null while it is unknown.

questions.description: Questions for the user in this reply; at most three.

missingFields.description: JSON paths of mandatory fields that are still missing.

document.description: Document data collected so far, or null.
